title: Canonical 850 (Purchase Order) — business document, direction-NEUTRAL
description: A Purchase Order's business facts. The SAME shape regardless of which side the client is on: it is the product's INPUT when the client SENDS an 850 (buyer/retailer role, e.g. VirVentures), and the product's OUTPUT when the client RECEIVES an 850 (supplier/vendor role, e.g. EMRY). Direction is a property of the (client, partner, docType) RELATIONSHIP, not of this schema — it selects build-vs-parse and which map runs. On inbound, `_meta` is populated; on outbound it is absent. PURE BUSINESS: no X12 quirks (those live in the map), no master data (config), no derived values (enrichment). Provenance: coreapp $eA. See README.md.

partnerKey.description: The trading partner on the OTHER side of this relationship; selects the map + partner master config. coreapp: VENDOR_PRIME_KEY / vendorRec.prefix.

poDate.description: coreapp: PURCHASE_ORDER_DATE. ISO; map formats to/from CCYYMMDD.

shipTo.description: Dropship destination as raw business fields (coreapp CUST_*). N1/N3/N4 split, address line breaking, state-name->code are the map's/enrichment's job.

references.description: Business references the client genuinely knows (e.g. department). NOT partner X12 qualifier choices — those belong in the map.

qty.description: coreapp: ORDERED_QTY. string OR number on purpose — coercion normalizes (engine-structure.md §3).

promoPrice.description: coreapp: SUPP_PROMO_PRICE; enrichment prefers it when > 0.

extensions.description: Escape hatch for true one-offs; recurring entries graduate to first-class fields once, for everyone.

_meta.description: Populated ONLY when this 850 was RECEIVED (supplier role). Absent on outbound.
